scenes.place: Corporate Castle (Tower of Vibes, Liability Tower, ER Dungeon)
scenes.incoming_state: High Lady Lexi maintains a protective ward over the ER Dungeon while Marissa and Sarai carry daily ER Watch operations.
scenes.turn: Disgusted at last by upper court politics, Lexi secures an Offline Oath from Doctor Lois, says farewell to Marissa and Sarai, and vanishes, leaving a leadership vacuum in Vibes. Caught between her Offline Oath and a Royal Volun-telling from Sterling, Lois cannot refuse; Sterling kicks the unfunded ER Watch across the moat to Liability Tower, where Marissa and Sarai find an abandoned wooden barge moored outside Liability Tower's drawbridge and move the Watch aboard without Lois's help.
scenes.outgoing_state: ER Watch is moored on an abandoned wooden barge outside Liability Tower's drawbridge with zero budget.

scenes.pov: Marissa + comedic cutaways (Tower of Vibes: Sienna/Orla; Liability Tower: Lois/Leo)
scenes.place: Abandoned wooden barge / Zoom lairs / Tower of Vibes / Liability Tower
scenes.incoming_state: ER Watch is newly settled on the abandoned wooden barge outside Liability Tower's drawbridge with zero budget; Courtiers of Optics still flood Marissa with fire drills.
scenes.turn: Real-time cold open: Marissa puts Elliot, High Lord of Engineering, in a 15-minute Deep Magic vise—protecting witness confidentiality while reading reported concerns ('Elliot, protect me' and laughing/doing nothing) against his 'preoccupied' / 'I don't recall' deflections, throwing 'preoccupied' back as 'not paying attention,' trapping his fake amnesia, and asking his obligation as a High Lord until his head snaps up in quiet fear and he folds in shame ('Absolutely. Absolutely.'). Marissa fires a brisk anti-retaliation Slack-rune to Sienna (without naming the complainant), and seconds later Liability Tower's brass loudspeaker broadcasts Lois's icy interim welcome while the Watch waves from the barge and Lois calmly pulls the velvet curtain shut. Cutaway to Sienna trapped in a 2-hour therapy session piecing Elliot's ego back together; Marissa closes the file cleanly with Lois and a stunned Baroness Orla (gold standard of Deep Magic working as meant; Marissa shrugs when Orla asks to tell Sterling), followed by Sir Leo's 'Like a knife through butter' Slack-rune and out-of-touch venting ('friendship tax'), Lois's 'packed by the door' cutaway, live barge Squire moments for Victoria and Riley, Sarai guarding the door, and the quiet 'only three weeks' Protected Exile hook.
scenes.outgoing_state: Marissa genuinely respects Lois's crisp rigor on ordinary risk, feels why Deep Magic is her calling, and steps up out of loyalty to cover the barge while Sarai leaves for Protected Exile.

scenes.pov: Marissa + comedic cutaways (Lois/Leo showdown behind closed doors, Sterling, Vibes)
scenes.place: Abandoned wooden barge / Liability Tower / Zoom lairs
scenes.incoming_state: Sarai's Protected Exile stretches toward three months; Marissa carries two full-time seats while Lois refuses to fight Sterling for contractor gold coin; Leo's dry wit and allyship come with the quiet friendship tax of out-of-touch venting and leaning on Marissa's heavy lifting.
scenes.turn: Marissa builds an airtight Formal Inquiry proving a High Lord is bullying their fiefdom and brings her pushback to Sir Leo first. Using his deeper mastery of Deep Magic's spell intricacies, Leo goes to bat for her—securing a Silk-Robed Sellsword of Outside Counsel to interview the High Lord on a technicality—and takes it to Doctor Lois, who explodes in fury behind closed doors. Leo absorbs the hit for Marissa and returns in coded language telling her he took it as far as he was able, forcing Marissa to swallow the bitter pill of agreeing to hollow coaching.
scenes.outgoing_state: Marissa's respect for Doctor Lois collapses completely—Lois is uncovered as a coward and hidden High Lord of Vibes hiding behind her red pen—while Marissa's complicated, deeply earned gratitude toward Leo locks in.

scenes.place: Zoom lairs across ER Dungeon, Liability Tower, and Tower of Vibes
scenes.incoming_state: Sarai returns from Protected Exile and resigns; Lois must break the news to Marissa and ship the Watch back to the Tower of Vibes.
scenes.turn: Lois fishes and deploys botched Illusion Magic ('Interim Captain'); Marissa raises The Mirror Shield, asks whether Orla is backfilling Sarai, refuses an immediate call with Orla, and hangs up on Lois. Afterward, before speaking with Orla, Marissa sends a calm severance scroll request offering an orderly transition as a peace offering. In a cutaway war-room scene, Sterling rejects it and approves Orla's zero-gold-coin Cashmere Coup to pull ER back to Vibes and quietly layer Marissa before Orla's call with Marissa.
scenes.outgoing_state: Peace offering rejected; ER Watch returns to the Tower of Vibes; Orla claims the Squires and leaves Riley exposed.

scenes.outgoing_state: Truce is dead; Marissa quietly plays her side of the board.
